chunks: And 'Āṣim ibn Ḥumayd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abī Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
If a man kills his mother by mistake, he inherits from her; and if he kills her intentionally, he does not inherit from her.

key_terms.لَمْ يَرِثْهَا: he did not inherit from her estate

ai.seo_question: Does a son inherit from his mother if he killed her accidentally or intentionally?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding inheritance in the case of matricide. It distinguishes between accidental killing, which does not prevent inheritance, and intentional killing, which bars the killer from inheriting from the victim.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5684 - Asim ibn Humeid narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said: "
If a man kills his mother by mistake, he inherits from her. However, if he kills her intentionally, he does not inherit from her."
